reads.description: This catalog: every read and table this connection can use.
One page of the owner's own rows from one table, in the columns the catalog lists for it.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous page of the same table.

reads.notes: Each column carries its own type and unit in tables[].columns. Rows come newest first on (timeColumn, id); follow page.nextCursor while page.hasMore, and a row added meanwhile is neither repeated nor skipped. from and to filter the table's timeColumn by owner-local day. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD with no time of day; instants are UTC ISO 8601.

reads.description: Stored account balances with their freshness, the rolling and monthly budget, upcoming recurring charges and this month's savings.
reads.notes: Accounts come 50 a page; the other sections repeat on every page and must not be summed across pages. A section in unavailableSections is null, never zero. Balances are stored, not live: quote freshness with them.

reads.description: A deterministic, model-free answer to one money question, with its arithmetic shown.

periodKey.description: A month (YYYY-MM), a calendar quarter (YYYY-Q1) or a year (YYYY).

piggyId.description: A piggy id from piggy_banks.list or the piggies table.

reads.notes: Structured amounts are cents; the answer's sentences write amounts as dollars. The structured reads are the better source for synthesis.

reads.description: Every transaction row of one period with its piggy, the period's piggies and the connected accounts.

periodKey.description: A month (YYYY-MM), a calendar quarter (YYYY-Q1) or a year (YYYY).

reads.notes: rowCount and truncated say whether the period held more rows than were returned; a truncated period must not be totalled.

reads.description: Every active piggy with its group, monthly target and rolling balance.
reads.notes: Groups are lowercase needs, wants and savings. balance is rolling since the budget start, not this month.

reads.description: How much can move from the primary checking account to savings without the next card bill overdrawing it, with the whole subtraction.
reads.notes: A negative result is shortfallCents, never a negative safe amount. Other checking accounts are excluded and listed.

reads.description: The full cash position: balances by account kind, net worth, the rolling and monthly budget, trends and the report card.
reads.notes: rawBudgetCents is Needs plus Wants rolling since the budget start: never call it this month's figure (monthlyBudget is the monthly frame). safeToSpendCents is a daily rate that counts income not yet received: never quote it as money on hand.

reads.description: Daily net-worth snapshots: cash, debt, investments and net worth.
reads.notes: A snapshot is taken only on days the owner opens the app; a missing day has no snapshot, not a zero.

reads.description: Income since the budget start, what was fed to piggies from it, Money to Feed, and month, quarter and year totals.
reads.notes: Dollars: items[].amount, totalIncome, totalFeedableIncome, totalFreedUp, totalAllocated, pointsEligibleAllocated, nonPointsEligibleAllocated, availableToFeed. Cents: every field ending in Cents, feedEvents[].totalCents, lifetime and periodStatsByMode. With no budget start date only part of the answer is present.

reads.description: Spending per Needs and Wants piggy, for the dashboard animation.
reads.notes: spentThisMonth sums charges (refunds ignored) from the EARLIER of the budget start date and this month's first day through today, so after the first budget month it covers the whole budget era, not the month. For this month use assistant.context budget.monthlyBudget.

reads.description: What was allocated to each savings piggy in one month and how much of it is covered.
reads.notes: totalSavings is dollars; allocByPiggy and coveredByPiggy are cents.

reads.description: For a piggy whose target is a percent of income: the percent, the income average it is taken of, and the resulting target.

piggyId.description: A piggy id from piggy_banks.list or the piggies table.

reads.notes: 404 unless the piggy is one of the owner's percent piggies. monthlyTarget is dollars, averageMonthlyIncomeCents is cents, incomePct is a percent.

reads.description: One piggy's recent transactions and spending summary: this month and the two before.

piggyId.description: A piggy id from piggy_banks.list or the piggies table.

reads.notes: Months are UTC calendar months. currentBalanceCents is all-time allocations minus all-time charges and can differ from the app's Balance; use piggy_banks.list for that.

reads.description: Whether there is enough spending history in the last 90 days for a rebalance, and the counts behind it.
The ledger rows of one period, newest first, optionally narrowed to some piggies.

period.description: A month (YYYY-MM), a calendar quarter (YYYY-Q1) or a year (YYYY).

piggy.description: Send the parameter once per piggy id.

reads.notes: amount is dollars, positive is money out. At most 1,000 rows; truncated says the oldest were cut.

reads.description: How many transactions have no piggy, per month, and with include=transactions the transactions themselves.
reads.notes: include=transactions lists every unassigned transaction with no paging; amount is dollars, positive is money out.

reads.description: Which banks are connected and when each connection last changed, from the database alone.
Piggy Points and the accessories owned and equipped; not money.
For one month: what was set aside for savings, what actually moved to savings, what is left to move and what can safely move now.
reads.notes: month defaults to the owner's current month and cannot be a later one.

reads.description: This month's savings tracker: money moved to savings against the goal, the honeycomb grid and points.
reads.notes: Read for an assistant without creating the month's row or awarding points: pointsAwarded is what is stored and pointsEarnedThisSync is 0. progressPct is uncapped.

tables.name: user_metadata
tables.description: Budget settings: budget start date, vibe, timezone, primary checking account and Piggy Points.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: budget_start_date
columns.description: First day of the budget era; balances and Money to Feed count from here.

columns.name: vibe
columns.description: Feed Me split: null is 50/30/20 Needs/Wants/Savings, stability 60/20/20, save_more 50/20/30, freedom 50/40/10.

columns.name: timezone
columns.description: IANA zone every owner-local date is resolved in.

tables.name: profiles
tables.description: The owner's display name and subscription state.

columns.name: id
columns.description: The owner's account id.

tables.name: plaid_items
tables.description: Bank connections: institution, sync state and when each was disconnected.

columns.name: disconnected_at
columns.description: Set when the connection was removed; its data is kept.

tables.name: accounts
tables.description: Bank, card and investment accounts with their last stored balances.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: plaid_item_id
columns.description: plaid_items.id.

columns.name: current_balance
columns.description: Last stored balance; for a credit card or loan, what is owed.

columns.name: last_synced_at
columns.description: When the balance was last stored; it is not live.

tables.name: transactions
tables.description: Every bank transaction that was not deleted, newest first, including pending rows and rows flagged as duplicates.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: accounts.id.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Positive is money out, negative is money in.

columns.name: date
columns.description: The bank's posting date, with no time of day.

columns.name: pending
columns.description: Pending rows count in no balance.

columns.name: is_duplicate
columns.description: A replay of another row; it counts in no total.

columns.name: is_income
columns.description: The one source of income in every calculation.

columns.name: piggy_id
columns.description: piggies.id the charge is assigned to; null is unassigned.

columns.name: affects_budget
columns.description: False for a row kept outside the budget.

tables.name: piggies
tables.description: Budget categories (piggies), their group and monthly target, including archived ones.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: group
columns.description: NEEDS, WANTS or SAVINGS.

columns.name: savings_share_pct
columns.description: Share of the savings pool (0-100); savings piggies only.

columns.name: income_pct
columns.description: Set when the monthly target is a percent of income; null is a dollar target.

tables.name: piggy_allocations
tables.description: Money fed into piggies (positive) and taken back out (negative).

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: source_transaction_id
columns.description: The income transaction that funded it, when known.

tables.name: piggy_rules
tables.description: Merchant rules that file a merchant's charges into a piggy.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

tables.name: piggy_balances
tables.description: Each piggy's rolling balance since the budget start: allocated minus posted spending.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.name: spent_cents
columns.description: Negative when refunds exceed charges.

tables.description: Per-transaction piggy overrides and hidden-from-stats flags.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

tables.name: category_tx_overrides

columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.

columns.description: The owner; always the connected account.
